dedupe_keys.name: optical wireless manufacturing network performance benchmark tables

description: This release contains performance tables for optical-wireless sensor-network configurations intended for electronics manufacturing. Muhammad Faheem and collaborators provide CSV results and paired figures for packet delivery, latency, congestion, throughput and packet error, alongside a diagram of the network arrangement. The independent variables include node density and operating rounds. Current Mendeley version 3 lists twelve CSV and PNG files free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is limited to the Kayseri, Turkey, setting named by the article, but the short metadata do not establish exact dates or a field-sampling interval. The file inventory shows aggregated benchmark outputs, so it should not be interpreted as a complete raw packet capture or an executable network model. This limits uses that require reconstructing individual devices or stochastic runs. A reviewer-assessed use is comparing communications-performance trends in industrial network simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related simulation environment, without verified direct compatibility. No data file, network configuration or performance calculation was executed.
name: Optical-wireless manufacturing-network performance benchmark tables
